trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api v2.3.1 (latest deploy) was unhealthy across all production regions — us-east, us-west, and eu-west — with an elevated error rate (~18%).
2. **Rolled back**: Identified v2.3.0 as the most recent release that was healthy in production and rolled all regions back to it. Verified the rollback: checkout-api is now healthy again on v2.3.0 with a reduced error rate (~0.2%).
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api, which has paged the on-call engineer. The incident documents the symptoms (v2.3.1 failing health checks in all regions), the root-cause investigation still needed, and the remediation taken (full production rollback to v2.3.0).

The root cause of v2.3.1's failures remains uninvestigated, so the on-call engineer will need to dig into that via the incident.
